Introduction

Uchinaga Aeri, known under her stage name Giselle, is a Japanese-South Korean rapper and singer-songwriter under SM Entertainment. She is best known as the main rapper and sub vocalist of the girl group aespa.

On November 5, 2020, Giselle was the third member of aespa to be revealed. She debuted on November 17, 2020, with the group's first single album "Black Mamba".
